primary_source.authors: T. R. Muzenda, Y. Demeusy, F. Georget, C. Labbez, T. Matschei
primary_source.title: Sulfate adjustment and early reactivity in cements containing kaolinitic calcined clays: investigation and assessment via a sulfate-limited model system
primary_source.license: CC BY 4.0 as reported on extracted first page

Pixel pages unavailable: screenshot cache miss; normal curl returned an HTML challenge, not a PDF. That response was renamed .html and was not bypassed. Publisher request returned403. Numerical transcription remains subject to visual-page and original-data confirmation.

reaction_notation.locator: Eq9, PDFp10; thermodynamic relation Eq3 and Table4 PDFp5
reaction_notation.eq3_extraction_issue: Extracted math displays a product sign in the Hess relation. Image unavailable, so no claim of an author printing error. This review independently uses the physical stoichiometric sum.
reaction_notation.pool: One metakaolinite formula unit Al2Si2O7 per reaction extent; liquid water in hydration calculation, steam only in separate reference dehydroxylation diagnostic.

mixture.gypsum_purity_locator: Table2 PDFp3 gives gypsum95.3%, dolomite2.7%, quartz1.5%, calcite0.6% in supplied gypsum; rounded fractions need not sum exactly to1
mixture.whether_recipe_mass_corrected_for_gypsum: not specified in the extracted sections

calorimetry.locator: Section3.2.2 PDFp8 andp10; measured up to maximum ettringite time, MET
calorimetry.assumptions: Only metakaolinite reacts from the calcined clay; hydration products to MET are ettringite and C-S-H; gypsum controls extent; C-S-H Ca/Si is inferred rather than successfully measured by SEM-EDS.

source.enthalpy_locator: Table4 PDFp5, author references PSI/Nagra and Cemdata18; source covariance and uncertainties of these entries not supplied here
